shade.rule: darken only: laterally, at the range's end and beyond, the case's color as in the legend; toward the midline its CIELAB L*, a* and b* multiplied by f = fmin + (1 - fmin) t, t = (d - start) / (end - start) held to [0, 1], d the distance from the midline of the drawn voxel nearest the viewer (the most lateral); the range is the 5th to 95th percentile of the drawn pixels' distances, whole mm
shade.key: Shade: midline [ramp] lateral, a light gray (0.85) under the same rule

transparency.outline: full opacity, shaded as its fill, 0.125 mm wide (two of the four subpixels of a 0.25 mm pixel)
transparency.casing: black, full opacity, outside each piece's outline, the given number of subpixels (0.0625 mm each), drawn under the piece
transparency.draw_order: each case's drawn voxels in pieces (26-connected); the pieces from the midline outward by their mean distance from it, so that the nearer the viewer lies on top; each piece's casing, fill, then outline

underlay.rule: the T2 image under the two side views is shown at this share of its brightness (its gray scale's upper end raised by 1 / share); the coronal slabs (b-d) are not dimmed
